title: Three Years and One Short Ledger
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：income　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 income 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the cashier ① earned the income that no neighbour in the bank would have recorded, and he said the earning was the whole of the month. The ② income, meaning the wage itself and not the ledger, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a income, he said, is the only thing in a bank that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ income in that bank had the same short ledger beside it, and the ④ income at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A income, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the cashier said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the income was the whole of the matter, meaning the security and not the wage. The ⑥ income, meaning the security and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; income, he said, is either something you earn or the only word that means both a wage and a security. He said the security is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ income had become a line in a statement, and the statement had become an argument about the short ledger. The ⑧ income of the whole thing, the cashier wrote in April, was one bank and three months of recording; income, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ income I remember is the wage recorded in the statement, which closed in 1989 and is still recorded as the quietest in the bank. A ⑩ income, my mother said in 1991, is the only wage that improves by being recorded; every income, she said, is a security that has agreed to look like a wage. She said the security was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 收入；所得（指银行里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 收入；所得（指那笔工资本身，与账簿相对）
C. 固定搭配：earn the income 挣得这笔收入
D. n. 收入；所得（指留给孩子们数的那一枚那一笔）
E. n. 收支之事（抽象总称，指一处银行的收入之事）
F. n. 收入；所得（指对账单里写到、被记下的的那一笔）
G. n. 保障、底气（指一件事里人人都算却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 底气（抽象总称，指人人都算却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: earned the income that no neighbour in the bank would have recorded
The income, meaning the wage itself and not the ledger
the income at the far counter
the income was the whole of the matter
the income had become a line in a statement
The income of the whole thing
A income, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: earn the income 意为“挣得这笔收入”，1982 年那位出纳把银行里没有一位邻居肯记录的一笔收入做了一遍。
income 意为“收入；所得”，指那笔工资本身而不是账簿，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被记录。
income 意为“收入；所得”，指银行里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一本薄薄的账簿。
income 意为“收入；所得”，指最远那段柜台留给孩子们数的那一枚那一笔，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
income 意为“保障、底气”，指一件事里人人都算却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份保障就是那件事的全部。
income 意为“底气”，指人人都算却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔工资，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
income 意为“收入；所得”，指对账单里写到、被记下的的那一笔，到 1987 年这一笔成了对账单里的一行。
income 意为“收支之事”，出纳四月写道，整件事的收入之事是一处银行和三个月的记录。
income 意为“收入；所得”，我记得的是对账单里记录过的那一笔，1989 年入账了，至今仍被说成银行里最安静的一笔。
income 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，收入是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的工资。
